cohort: The study included thirty preterm infants (23 to 37 weeks gestational age) attending in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
finding: There was no significant difference in auditory function (measured by OME and ABR) between preterm infants treated with SIMV and those treated with NCPAP.
mod_finding: There was an increase in Caesarean section (CS) mode deliveries in the NCPAP group (86.7%) compared to the SIMV group (40%).
